description: List all countries and territories tracked by ReliefWeb, optionally filtered to active humanitarian situations. Returns ISO3 codes and status for each entry — use the ISO3 code with reliefweb_get_country to fetch a full profile. Set crisis_only=true to limit results to countries with active humanitarian situations.

crisis_only.description: When true, filters to countries with an active humanitarian situation (status ongoing). Default false returns all countries.

limit.description: Number of results to return (1–1000, default 100). Each call counts against the 1,000-calls/day quota.

offset.description: Zero-based offset for pagination. Use with limit and the totalCount enrichment field to page through results.

name: reliefweb_list_countries

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_query`: ReliefWeb rejected the request as malformed rather than failing to serve it. `upstream_error`: The ReliefWeb API was unreachable, timed out, or returned a server error. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

items.description: A country or territory tracked by ReliefWeb.

iso3.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code for use with reliefweb_get_country.

status.description: Humanitarian situation status: ongoing (active crisis) or normal (non-crisis).

urlAlias.description: Canonical ReliefWeb URL for this country page.

notice.description: Present only when the page is empty. Names the match count and the last reachable offset when the query matched records; otherwise echoes the filters applied and suggests how to broaden.

totalCount.description: Total countries matching the filter before pagination.

title: List ReliefWeb Countries
